findings.title: Codex skill reads disappear in the feedback summary
findings.evidence: The Codex logger emits source=hook-skill-read; aggregate_feedback.py counts only source=hook. A native audit found 549 such Codex events plus five agent records, while the aggregator reported zero hook use across 43 logs.
findings.cost: False missing-hook warnings and unreliable decisions about unused skills.
findings.smallest_fix: Recognize both event kinds, separate reads from invocations, and include both client roots.

findings.title: Missing instruction files can appear as successful skips
findings.evidence: The mirror checker scanned 188 entries and produced nine issues, while 67 entries were ok:true/status:skipped for missing CLAUDE.md. Direct inventory separately found 43 active configured roots without instruction files. Non-repository collections are distinguished.
findings.cost: Coverage reports conceal roots needing instructions or explicit exemption.
findings.smallest_fix: Classify missing-both as incomplete; accept valid AGENTS-only sources and documented exemptions.

findings.title: A plan gate can ask for completed work before admitting that work
findings.evidence: The coordinated ownership judge demanded completed work-unit evidence during prospective adoption. Exact future handoff evidence tables finally admitted the root and maintenance plans; prior gate outcomes changed between revisions.
findings.cost: Repeated paid semantic reviews and a delayed three-line diagnostic repair.
findings.smallest_fix: Separate prospective owner assignments and handoff criteria from execution proof; bound clarification rounds.
findings.rechecked: observed native adoption outcomes; both plans now admitted

findings.title: Repeated feedback events and missing client identity distort usage counts
findings.evidence: Claude feedback contained 1,183 rows but 892 exact distinct events, with 291 extra copies; 1,116 lacked client identity. A timestamp alone is not an invocation identity.
findings.cost: Usage and parity comparisons can count the same event twice or mix clients.
findings.smallest_fix: Use a stable invocation/event identifier and client attribution; preserve distinct events sharing a timestamp.

findings.title: Codex child roles still inherit the large workspace bootstrap
findings.evidence: A native child launched with project_doc_max_bytes=0 contained a 72,320-character bootstrap and began with 37,225 input tokens. The compact role setting did not remove the inherited user instructions.
findings.cost: Specialist role files alone do not deliver Codex context savings.
findings.smallest_fix: Use and verify a native fresh-session boundary with explicit compact safety instructions; preserve the inherited-child limitation until measured.
findings.rechecked: live inherited-child isolation test failed; fresh-session probe running
